identityReviewRetry.reason: The source thick substantial handlebar moustache and pale blue-grey irises were changed into a fine styled moustache and brown-grey eyes.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Native Reneric has a broad heavy bushy handlebar moustache whose curled ends extend beyond mouth corners, a pointed central goatee and pale blue-grey eyes.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Photograph retains upward curls and pointed goatee but the moustache is thin and narrow through its centre, and eyes appear darker brown-grey.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Make Reneric's irises clearly PALE BLUE-GREY in natural daylight, not brown. Restore a THICK BUSHY dark brown handlebar moustache with substantial dense hair covering the upper lip and broad natural volume across it; keep both curled upturned ends beyond the mouth corners. It must not be a fine pencil or thread moustache. Keep the compact pointed goatee and mostly clean cheeks, centre-parted ear-length brown hair, broad youthful rounded face and age twenty.
